label: Style
help: Scroll cinema opens full-height with one scene per link. Aurora glass, Front page, Cover story and Playroom are expressive landing pages built from the design system's colours and type; Buttons, Cards and Minimal are plain lists.

label: Mood
help: How far the page moves. Each style animates something different, and the plain lists do not move at all. A visitor who asks for reduced motion always gets the still page.

label: Text colour
help: The page reads in both colour schemes: whichever pair of text and background you set, the other one is derived from it, and a visitor sees the one their device asks for.

label: Accent
help: Colours the buttons, the glass glow and the link marks.

label: Show the Lolly line
help: A visible "Made with Lolly" line closing the animated styles. Nothing is embedded in the link either way - turning it off simply removes the line.

label: Links
help: Up to ten links, one per row. The address goes first; a blank name shows the site's own name, and a tap in the Emoji column picks a glyph. Nothing is stored on a server: the whole page travels inside the share link.

label: Sub-heading
placeholder: One link for all of it.

label: Portrait
help: A face or logo above the heading. A catalog or design system asset travels as a tiny reference, so the share link stays short; an uploaded picture only opens on this device unless the link is packed.

label: Backdrop
help: A full-bleed picture behind the page. The Cover story style builds its whole opening from it; Aurora dims it under the glass. Catalog and design system assets keep the share link tiny.

label: On visit
help: "Forward" turns the page into a redirect to the first link - a URL forwarder. Add a password in the Share dialog for a password-gated forwarder. "Forward after a human check" adds a press-and-hold step first, so a casual bot following the link does not sail straight through. The check is a speed bump, not proof: whoever holds a link without a password can still read where it points.
